item.title: 'Amelia' From UK Government Game About The Dangers Of Extremism Becomes Far-Right Twitter Waifu
item.description: Amelia is a supporting character in the UK government-funded educational visual novel Pathways, a game developed by Shout Out UK to teach the youth about extremism and radicalization. In the game, Amelia is a far-right anti-immigration activist with purple hair and a goth appearance, who tries persuading the protagonist to join her cause. item.title: Zohran Mamdani And Ms. Rachel Sing 'Wheels On The Bus' At New York Kindergarten Class, Become A Reaction Meme
item.description: Zohran Mamdani and Ms. Rachel "Wah Wah Wah" refers to a viral video and reaction image meme of children's content creator Ms. Rachel singing "Wheels on the Bus" with New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani. item.title: RFK Jr. Announces New, Inverted Food Pyramid, Bringing An Iconic 'South Park' Scene To Life
item.description: RFK Jr.'s Inverted Food Pyramid refers to U.S. Secretary of Health and Human Services RFK Jr.'s plan to essentially invert the food pyramid, placing protein, dairy, healthy fats, vegetables and fruits at the top and whole grains at the bottom. The change, announced in January 2026, comes after inquiries about the effectiveness and accuracy of the traditional food pyramid.
